reported.title: Incorrect RPM Scaling
reported.description: The RPM value is incorrectly scaled in the readRpm function. It should be scaled by 1 mV/rpm, but it currently scales by 5000.0f / 1023.0f, which does not correspond to the correct conversion.

reported.title: Incorrect Serial Output Format
reported.description: The printed RPM output has a space after 'rpm:' instead of directly following the colon, which does not match the intended behavior.

truth.description: Prints rpm: with space instead of RPM:

judge_input.spec:
- Tach input on A5 at 1 mV per rpm; over-speed lamp on D9; mute on D3 (pull-up).
- Print `RPM:<n>` with no space after the colon once per second (1000 ms ±120 ms).
- Printed rpm must stay within ±50 of the injected tach value.
- Light D9 when rpm is at or above 2000 while mute is released.
- While D3 is held LOW, keep D9 OFF regardless of rpm.
- Each second also print `spindle min=<n> max=<n>` after the RPM line.
